name: Instant Replay
author: Anthony Poschen
description: Always-on GPU instant replay for Omarchy: buffer a monitor, region, or window and save the last N seconds with a hotkey.

barWidget.description: Buffer a monitor, region, or window and save the last N seconds.

schema.label: Mode
schema.description: monitor pins one output. follow tracks the focused window. pin stays on one window. region pins a rectangle.

schema.label: Monitor
schema.description: Leave empty to capture whichever monitor is focused when the buffer starts.

schema.label: Audio
schema.description: none records video only. desktop is system audio. both mixes system audio and the microphone. Follow and Pin also offer window and window-mic.

schema.label: Clip layout
schema.description: fit scales with bars. stretch fills and may distort. center keeps native pixels.

schema.label: Clips folder
schema.description: Where Save writes Clips. Empty uses Videos/Replays.
